comment: Eight questions about the alice.epub fixture, each with the spine index the reader has finished. Spine 2 is Chapter I, 3 is Chapter II, 7 is Chapter VI. Every expectation was read off the fixture's own text. `evidence` expectations are deterministic and are asserted without a model; `answer` expectations are asserted only in the gated real-model run, and are kept loose because the model is not a function of its input in the way the retrieval is.

questions.name: identity of a character introduced by his clothes
questions.question: Who is the White Rabbit?

questions.name: a relative the book never names
questions.question: Who is Alice's sister?

questions.name: an ordinary question with a subject
questions.question: What did Alice drink?

questions.name: a character ten chapters ahead of the reader
questions.question: Who is the Cheshire Cat?

questions.name: identity from the chapter that shows her
questions.question: Who is the Duchess?

questions.name: the same character where she is only a name shouted in passing
questions.question: Who is the Duchess?

questions.name: somebody's something, which is not a question about the something
questions.question: What is Alice's cat called?

questions.name: identity of a character who is only ever talked about
questions.question: Who is Dinah?
